residual_risks: Autoreview round-3 P1 (interactive-ask override) ACCEPTED on its third press — jobs configured with a non-ask permission mode would otherwise run the retry without asking — and IMPLEMENTED: the bound scheduler_retry_ask trigger's requestedBy sets that run's spawn permissionMode to 'ask' (execution-runtime-events.ts interactiveAskOverride → execution-phases-run.ts baseInput); the job definition is never mutated. If trigger binding fails, the run degrades to the job's configured mode (bind failure returns {}).

Autoreview round-4 P1 'retry replay can enqueue an already-dispatched trigger again' REJECTED with code evidence: enqueueSchedulerTriggerDelivery sends with a deterministic pg-boss id derived from the trigger id (pgBossSendId(jobId,'trigger:<triggerId>'), scheduler-engine.ts), and pg-boss 12.26.4 insertJobs uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with createJob returning null on the skipped duplicate — concurrent or repeated taps converge on ONE queue row. Independently, claimDueCanonicalJobRunStart fences the deterministic run id in one transaction (existing non-expired run/lease ⇒ null claim). Invariant documented inline at the replay enqueue.
A stale pause card tapped after a NEWER pause of the same job fires retry for the current pause (tap-time fingerprint); same job, same owner intent — accepted and documented.
Live Slack/Discord/Teams button taps not exercised end-to-end pre-merge; the deploy live-check covers Slack.
